_comment: Read by the project-drive skill at the start of each round. The skill proposes before it acts; nothing in this file lets it skip the approval (Auto Drive, the drive:auto label on the drive issue, is the standing approval). runners: how many agents may work at once. maxAgents: the most one round dispatches once approved. maxMinutes: the most one round runs before it reports and stops. queueLogGlob: where the merge queue writes its logs, so a stale one can be proposed for restart. ownerDecisions: short phrases naming what is always the owner's; a ready issue whose title or body mentions one is asked about once, never started. unitsPerRound: the most units (a bundle of issues touching the same files, or one loose issue, each one agent and one pull request) a round holds, within maxAgents; default 2. dispatchModel: the model each unit's agent runs on; default empty, the model the agent-model hook allows for the issue's tier. setAsideAfterReds: a pull request red this many times (on different commits) is set aside with a plain comment instead of fixed again; default 2, 0 never. summaryAt: the local time (HH:MM) of the once-a-day summary on the drive issue; default empty, no summary. healthNote: an optional machine-health figure; command prints one number, name says what it is, above is where a restart is recommended. It only recommends and never pauses work; an empty command (the default) means no note. For example, the load average on Linux or macOS: {"command": "uptime | sed 's/.*load averages*: //' | cut -d, -f1", "name": "the load average", "above": 8}.
